name: worx-safety
description: Australian workplace health and safety (WHS) compliance via Worx Safety. Manage inductees, documents, issues, assets, projects, and registers — all WHS obligations in one place.

connection.instructions: Generate an API token in Worx Safety: Settings → API Tokens → Create Token. Select the permissions you need (user-read, asset-read, sites-read, documents-read at minimum). Copy the token immediately — it is only shown once.
